concerns.text: Task T007b instructs generating a 'synthetic Golden Set' using heuristic proxies. This directly contradicts Spec FR-001 (requires 'expert-labeled interactions'), Plan Phase 0 ('No synthetic or heuristic proxies'), and Constitution Principle VI (requires validation against NASA-TLX or expert data). There is no task covering the mandatory 'Halt' condition for missing external data without a fallback to synthetic generation.

Task T015 covers model training and saving but omits the mandatory collinearity diagnostic (VIF ≤ 5) required by Spec SC-005 and FR-005. While T016 exists separately, T015's description of the training loop does not explicitly include the VIF check as a gating condition before saving the model artifact, risking a missing requirement implementation.

Task T033 describes a sensitivity analysis sweeping 'low to moderate significance levels' but fails to specify the exact threshold values {0.01, 0.05, 0.1} mandated by Spec SC-003. The task relies on the implementer to infer the specific set, which is a missing explicit requirement for the simulation step.

Task T003 requests configuration of linting (ruff/flake8) and formatting (black) tools. The Spec and Plan contain no requirements for code style enforcement or specific linters. This task appears to be an orphan addition not derived from any FR/SC or Plan element.

Tasks T045 ('Struggle Preservation' metric) and T046b ('Average Errors Per Session') introduce new metrics derived from reviewer comments ('System 2 effort'). These metrics lack a corresponding Success Criterion (SC) or Functional Requirement (FR) in the Spec, making them untestable against the defined acceptance criteria and potentially scope-creeping.
